claims.statement: The Foo Valley Municipal Utility said a water main burst in Eastfield on 20 November 2024 and that it issued a boil notice for 3,400 customers until 23 November 2024.

sources.title: Service notice: main burst, Eastfield
sources.supporting_excerpt: A water main burst in Eastfield on 20 November 2024, and the utility issued a boil notice for 3,400 customers until 23 November 2024.

sources.title: Brown water in Eastfield
sources.supporting_excerpt: Eastfield residents told the Lower Basin Inquirer that the tap water ran brown on 20 November 2024, and reporters saw crews digging at the junction of Mill Road.

claims.notes: The Inquirer reports independently on the event; it gives no figure.
